description: Förderung Radwege Niederösterreich is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sdi.noe.gv.at. In connection with the further development of the NÖ cycle path network, a potential analysis for everyday cycling was carried out in Lower Austria. As a result of the analysis, municipalities were clustered into several regions in which bicycle base networks are to be created. Coverage: AT. The portal shows the English title as "Promotion of cycle paths Lower Austria" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Radweg. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WFS, SHP, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.de). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
